data.title: Binance Hack Sparks Bitcoin Sell-Off, $1.6B In Liquidations: Exchange Uncovers ‘Additional Points Of Breach’
data.description: CoinGlass data showed that over $1.6 billion in crypto bets had been wiped out, with long positions accounting for $1.35 billion.
